lines.quote: can you point to an extant example of it that works? Venezuela… does it work?
lines.note: the test, with the hard case first

lines.quote: no… some are bad, some are medium, some work better — but the commitment is to the dignity of ordinary people
it's not an ism, brother — it's about decency, fairness, the accountability of the powerful
lines.note: renames the word into its aim

lines.quote: if that's what democratic socialism is, I'm basically on board… current systems make it hard for them to have dignity… but the details
lines.note: agrees with the aim; the system is failing them

lines.quote: Einstein, Helen Keller, Eugene Debs, Martin Luther King Jr. — they're all democratic socialists
has it struck you as interesting that it's never actually worked anywhere… Venezuela… they don't have toilet paper
lines.note: back to the hard case; the coalition move

lines.quote: our goals are the same — how do we get there is the question
lines.note: puts the disagreement where it is: means, not ends
